maddeler.e:
تضايقت (form VI)
# تَضَايَقْتُ (taḍāyaqtu) /ta.dˤaː.jaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَضَايَقَ (taḍāyaqa)
# تَضَايَقْتَ (taḍāyaqta) /ta.dˤaː.jaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَضَايَقَ (taḍāyaqa)
# تَضَايَقْتِ (taḍāyaqti) /ta.dˤaː.jaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَضَايَقَ (taḍāyaqa)
# تَضَايَقَتْ (taḍāyaqat) /ta.dˤaː.ja.qat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
